metadata.title: Meaning classification supplement for image-selection research
metadata.purpose: AI-authored pilot definitions and semantic labels for reviewing which evidence a still image would need to show.
metadata.authorship: AI-authored pilot; not expert-reviewed and not a claim of human annotation.
metadata.visualAnnotations: No visual images were reviewed or annotated for these examples.
metadata.labelingBasis: Labels describe semantic evidence required to verify the selected sense from a still image; they are not part-of-speech rules or image classifier confidence labels.
metadata.families: familyId groups senses sharing a headword; contrastive senses such as pet and blood remain in one family.

examples.definition: A companion animal kept for affection or company.
examples.requiredEvidence: An animal shown as a companion in a domestic context.
examples.misleadingAlternative: A wild animal near a person does not by itself show that it is someone’s companion.
examples.rationale: The deciding cue is An animal shown as a companion in a domestic context.; A wild animal near a person does not by itself show that it is someone’s companion. could occur without the selected meaning.
